message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will upload a Python package using Twine when the test-pypi branch is modified
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/en/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions#publishing-to-package-registries

name: Upload Python package to TestPyPI

# uncomment the following to upload to TestPyPI
# on:
#   workflow_run: 
#     workflows: ["snnTorch CD"]
#     # branches: [main] 
#     types:
#       - completed
on:
  push:
    branches: [ test-pypi ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ test-pypi ]

jobs:

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v7
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install setuptools wheel twine
    
    # Upload to TestPyPI
    - name: Build and upload to TestPyPI
      run: |
        python3 setup.py sdist bdist_wheel
        python3 -m twine upload dist/*
      env:
        TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
        TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TWINE_TEST_TOKEN }}
        TWINE_REPOSITORY: testpypi

    # - name: Build and publish
    #   env:
    #     TWINE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.PYPI_USERNAME }}
    #     TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_PASSWORD }}
    #   run: |
    #     python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel
    #     twine upload dist/*",
  "rationale": "The workflow reinstalls pip dependencies (pip, setuptools, wheel, twine) on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) is supported by evidence showing measurable benefit from caching pip dependencies in Python CI workflows. Adding an actions/cache step before dependency installation preserves all build/upload steps and required checks, with no new privileges, secrets, publishing operations, or network access beyond what pip already performs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}

# This workflow will upload a Python package using Twine when the test-pypi branch is modified
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/en/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions#publishing-to-package-registries

name: Upload Python package to TestPyPI

on:

    branches: [ test-pypi ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ test-pypi ]

jobs:

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v7
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install setuptools wheel twine
    
    # Upload to TestPyPI
    - name: Build and upload to TestPyPI
      run: |
        python3 setup.py sdist bdist_wheel
        python3 -m twine upload dist/*
      env:
        TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
        TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TWINE_TEST_TOKEN }}
        TWINE_REPOSITORY: testpypi
